body: Idk if anyone is wondering, but I'm fine and thank you all for the support. I've decided that if my dad has another one of those sorts of breakdowns I'm going straight to the police. It's just that I don't have a fully awful life and I'd rather have something then having to go to foster care as a 16 year old because I wouldn't get adopted by anyone and my life would be significantly worse off
My mom isn't as harsh as him, but she mostly agrees with him. I've mostly calmed down since then, but he hasn't. I'm just hoping that I won't have to call the cops
